title: History, correction and deletion
brief: Represent agreements and changing facts with explicit effective and recorded times. Carry corrections, retention and deletion through related and external records without rewriting the meaning of historical purchases.

neighbouring_ownership.data-modelling: Owns first current-price versus agreed-price distinction.
neighbouring_ownership.backups: Owns restoring an earlier database history and reconciling valid work.

title: Query execution and performance
brief: Follow rows through scans, joins, grouping and sorting. Use measured plans to locate bad cardinality estimates, repeated work, spills and data movement; test a repair against realistic parameters and workload.

neighbouring_ownership.indexes: Owns access-path design, not all query repair.
neighbouring_ownership.incidents: Owns separating execution work from admission and lock waits.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-plans: Owns native PostgreSQL counters and plan behaviour.

title: Live schema changes and backfills
brief: Move through compatible schema and caller states using expand, migrate and contract. Prove a backfill converged despite races and late rows, and define acceptance and return boundaries.

neighbouring_ownership.writes: Owns import mechanics outside a live compatibility protocol.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns PostgreSQL locks, rewrites and index validity.

title: Sharding and distributed SQL
brief: Choose a distribution boundary from local work, invariant scope and the actual bottleneck. Distinguish replicas from shards, explain authoritative replicated history, acknowledgements and quorum availability, and separate agreement within one partition from atomic commit across partitions. Derive locality, skew, fan-out and coordination from the key.

neighbouring_ownership.placement: Owns latency and survival across failure domains.
neighbouring_ownership.replicas: Owns copied-history progress and read routing; distribution establishes quorum-based agreement within one replicated partition.
